40	 * @param raw - the raw value; defaults to `process.env.DSH_EXAMPLE_MODE`.
41	 * @returns the validated mode.
42	 */
43	export function resolveExampleMode(raw: string | undefined = process.env[EXAMPLE_MODE_ENV]): ExampleMode {
44	  switch (raw) {
45	    case undefined:
46	    case '':
47	    case 'src':
48	      return 'src'
49	    case 'lib':
50	      return 'lib'
51	    default:
52	      throw new Error(`${EXAMPLE_MODE_ENV} must be 'src' or 'lib', got ${JSON.stringify(raw)}.`)
53	  }
54	}

56	/** Inputs to {@link resolveExampleLaunch}. */
57	export interface ExampleLaunchOptions {
58	  /** Absolute path to the example bin's TypeScript source entry (`<pkg>/src/bin.ts`); the `lib` bin is derived from it. */
59	  readonly srcBin: string
60	  /** Explicit plain-Node entry for `lib` mode; test fixtures may point this at Node-type-strippable TypeScript. */
61	  readonly libBin?: string | undefined
62	  /** Arguments passed after the bin — the config, positional (`[configPath]`) or flagged (`['--config', configPath]`). */
63	  readonly configArgs?: readonly string[]
64	  /** The mode to launch in; defaults to {@link resolveExampleMode} of the environment. */
65	  readonly mode?: ExampleMode
66	  /** Absolute repo tsconfig whose `paths` map resolves unbuilt workspace imports. Required in `src` mode, ignored in `lib`. */
67	  readonly tsconfigPath?: string
68	  /** Select the ESM-only tsx hook instead of the generic loader. */
69	  readonly sourceImport?: 'tsx/esm'
70	  /** Extra environment entries the mode-specific ones layer over; the caller then merges the result over `process.env`. */
71	  readonly env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv
72	}
73	
74	/** The resolved spawn: `spawn(command, args, { env: { ...process.env, ...env } })`. */
75	export interface ExampleLaunch {
76	  /** The executable to spawn — always the current Node binary. */
77	  readonly command: string
78	  /** Node flags, the resolved bin, then the caller's `configArgs`. */
79	  readonly args: string[]
80	  /** Mode-specific environment (`TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH` in `src`, nothing added in `lib`) layered over the caller's `env`. */
81	  readonly env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv
82	}
83	
84	/** Derive the built-lib bin (`<pkg>/lib/<name>.js`) from a source bin (`<pkg>/src/<name>.ts`). */
85	function toLibBin(srcBin: string): string {
86	  const markerLength = '/src/'.length
87	  const cut = Math.max(srcBin.lastIndexOf('/src/'), srcBin.lastIndexOf('\\src\\'))
88	  if (cut === -1) {
89	    throw new Error(`resolveExampleLaunch: expected a "/src/" segment or Windows equivalent in bin path ${JSON.stringify(srcBin)}.`)
90	  }
91	  const separator = srcBin.slice(cut, cut + 1)
92	  const tail = srcBin.slice(cut + markerLength).replace(/\.ts$/, '.js')
93	  return `${srcBin.slice(0, cut)}${separator}lib${separator}${tail}`
94	}

96	/**
97	 * Resolve how to spawn an example bin in the selected mode.
98	 *
99	 * `src` yields `node --import <tsx> <srcBin> <configArgs>` with `TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH` set so the
100	 * tsconfig `paths` map resolves workspace imports to source. `lib` yields
101	 * `node <libBin> <configArgs>` under plain Node with no tsx and no paths map, so
102	 * bare package plugins resolve through real package `exports` into built `lib/`; relative example-local
103	 * TypeScript plugins remain source files loaded through Node's built-in type stripping. Bare resolution
104	 * requires the config to live below a workspace that declares its `cordis.yml` package dependencies.
105	 *
106	 * @param options - the source bin, config arguments, mode, and environment.
107	 * @returns the command, argument vector, and mode-specific environment to spawn with.
108	 */
109	export function resolveExampleLaunch(options: ExampleLaunchOptions): ExampleLaunch {
110	  const mode = options.mode ?? resolveExampleMode()
111	  const configArgs = options.configArgs ?? []
112	  const env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = { ...options.env }
113	
114	  if (mode === 'src') {
115	    if (options.tsconfigPath === undefined) {
116	      throw new Error("resolveExampleLaunch: 'src' mode needs tsconfigPath for the workspace paths map.")
117	    }
118	    const tsxLoader = options.sourceImport === 'tsx/esm'
119	      ? import.meta.resolve('tsx/esm')
120	      : import.meta.resolve('tsx')
121	    env.TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH = options.tsconfigPath
122	    return { command: process.execPath, args: ['--import', tsxLoader, options.srcBin, ...configArgs], env }
123	  }
124	
125	  return { command: process.execPath, args: [options.libBin ?? toLibBin(options.srcBin), ...configArgs], env }
126	}

128	/** Inputs that vary between real-Loader example smokes. */
129	export interface LoaderSmokeOptions {
130	  /** Human-readable example name used in failure diagnostics. */
131	  readonly label: string
132	  /** Prefix for the isolated temporary process cwd. */
133	  readonly tempDirPrefix: string
134	  /** Existing parent for the generated cwd; defaults to the platform temporary directory. */
135	  readonly tempDirParent?: string
136	  /** Absolute app-bin source path (`<pkg>/src/bin.ts`); the `lib` bin is derived from it. */
137	  readonly binScript: string
138	  /** Explicit plain-Node entry for `lib` mode; intended for test fixtures outside a package `src/` tree. */
139	  readonly libBinScript?: string | undefined
140	  /** Absolute real Loader config path, passed as the sole bin argument by default. */
141	  readonly configPath: string
142	  /** Complete argv after the bin path; overrides the default `[configPath]`. */
143	  readonly binArgs?: readonly string[]
144	  /** Absolute repo tsconfig path used for unbuilt workspace-package resolution (required in `src` mode). */
145	  readonly tsconfigPath: string
146	  /** Boot from source via tsx (`src`) or built lib via plain Node (`lib`); defaults to the environment's mode. */
147	  readonly mode?: ExampleMode
148	  /** Environment overrides layered over the parent and isolated DSH homes. */
149	  readonly env?: Readonly<NodeJS.ProcessEnv>
150	  /** Process deadline override for harness tests. */
151	  readonly processTimeoutMs?: number
152	  /** Optional world-state setup run in the isolated cwd before process start. */
153	  readonly prepare?: (cwd: string) => Promise<void> | void
154	  /** Optional world-state assertion run in the isolated cwd before cleanup. */
155	  readonly inspect?: (cwd: string) => Promise<void> | void
156	  /**
157	   * Exact process exit code this smoke expects; defaults to `0`. Scenarios
158	   * pinning a designed failure surface (a one-shot turn ending in an error
159	   * result) declare its nonzero exit here, and a run that exits any other
160	   * way — including succeeding — still fails the smoke.
161	   */
162	  readonly expectedExitCode?: number
163	}
164	
165	/** Captured output from a Loader smoke that exited successfully. */
166	export interface LoaderSmokeResult {
167	  /** Complete stdout after clean exit. */
168	  readonly stdout: string
169	  /** Complete stderr after clean exit. */
170	  readonly stderr: string
171	}
172	
173	/**
174	 * Boot one real Loader tree from an isolated cwd, close stdin immediately, and
175	 * await a clean exit. The helper owns process kill and temp-directory cleanup on
176	 * every outcome, and picks src/lib via {@link resolveExampleLaunch}.
177	 * @param options - example paths, mode, environment, and diagnostic identity.
178	 * @returns captured stdout and stderr after a zero exit.
179	 */
180	export async function runLoaderSmoke(options: LoaderSmokeOptions): Promise<LoaderSmokeResult> {
181	  const cwd = await mkdtemp(join(options.tempDirParent ?? tmpdir(), options.tempDirPrefix))
182	  const processTimeoutMs = options.processTimeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_PROCESS_TIMEOUT_MS
183	  try {
184	    await options.prepare?.(cwd)
185	    const launch = resolveExampleLaunch({
186	      srcBin: options.binScript,
187	      libBin: options.libBinScript,
188	      configArgs: options.binArgs ?? [options.configPath],
189	      ...options.mode !== undefined ? { mode: options.mode } : {},
190	      tsconfigPath: options.tsconfigPath,
191	      env: {
192	        DSH_HOME: join(cwd, '.dsh'),
193	        DSH_AGENTS_HOME: join(cwd, '.agents'),
194	        ...options.env,
195	      },
196	    })
197	    // `input: ''` writes nothing and closes stdin — the fixture-visible
198	    // stdin-close contract. `reject: false` folds spawn errors, the SIGKILL
199	    // deadline, and nonzero exits into independent result fields, so the
200	    // diagnostics below embed both streams on every failure.
201	    const result = await execa(launch.command, launch.args, {
202	      cwd,
203	      env: launch.env,
204	      input: '',
205	      timeout: processTimeoutMs,
206	      killSignal: 'SIGKILL',
207	      reject: false,
208	      stripFinalNewline: false,
209	    })
210	    if (result.timedOut) {
211	      throw new Error(`${options.label} did not exit within ${processTimeoutMs / 1_000}s. stdout:\n${result.stdout}\nstderr:\n${result.stderr}`)
212	    }
213	    const expectedExitCode = options.expectedExitCode ?? 0
214	    if (result.exitCode !== expectedExitCode) {
215	      throw new Error(`${options.label} exited ${String(result.exitCode)} (expected ${expectedExitCode}). stdout:\n${result.stdout}\nstderr:\n${result.stderr}`)
216	    }
217	    await options.inspect?.(cwd)
218	    return { stdout: result.stdout, stderr: result.stderr }
219	  } finally {
220	    await rm(cwd, { recursive: true, force: true })
221	  }
222	}
